headline: Butterfield Bermuda: Blanchet leads after opening 62; Round 2 underway
whyCareReason: Chandler Blanchet shot a 9-under 62 with two eagles to take the lead. Round 2 is underway at Port Royal.
teaser: Blanchet leads at 9-under 62. Conners, Kohles, Walker trail at 63 (-7). Round 2 underway Friday.
story: Round 2 of the Butterfield Bermuda Championship opened Friday morning, 23 October, at Port Royal Golf Course in Southampton, Bermuda. Chandler Blanchet set the early tournament pace with a career-low 9-under-par 62 on Thursday, holing two eagles including a 50-foot putt on the par-5 17th hole. A tight chasing pack sits two shots behind, with Canadian Corey Conners, Ben Kohles, Danny Walker and Ben Silverman all tied at 7-under-par 63. The 120-player field is chasing a $6 million purse and 500 FedExCup Fall points along the Robert Trent Jones oceanfront course.
stakes: FedExCup Fall points are on the line as 120 players battle ocean crosswinds at Port Royal.
rivalryAngle: Blanchet sets the target while established tour stars pursue during Friday's second round.
